context: Two-partner firm. Enquiries come from a contact form, a shared inbox, and referrals.
docs: Owner wrote: we lose track of quotes when the inbox gets busy.

form.businessDescription: A two-partner bookkeeping firm serving small agencies and consultancies that have outgrown a spreadsheet.
form.targetAudience: Owners of 5-20 person agencies who need monthly books, payroll support, and someone to answer tax questions.
form.brandPersonality: Calm, precise, plain-spoken. We explain the number before we recommend the fix.
form.competitors: Local accounting practices that bundle bookkeeping into annual accounts, and a few online bookkeeping services.
form.goals: Respond to every new enquiry within one working day and stop losing quote requests in the shared inbox.
form.toneExamples: Here is what happens next, and who does it.
form.offLimits: No jargon, no guarantees about tax outcomes, never mention competitor pricing.
